          SPECIFICATION
          
Technical Notes

          
Fixed pattern: email-like strings OR #INV- followed by digits. Reports matched text and positions. This utility is not a configurable regular-expression editor and does not validate email deliverability.

          
Frequently Asked Questions

          
Can I enter an arbitrary regex?
This focused finder uses a fixed email/invoice pattern. It does not accept custom regular expressions or claim to validate every possible email address.
